description: This file defines the class DefaultMappingConfig, which is an implementation of the MappingConfig interface. It manages configuration settings related to mapping, including buffer size, parallelism, max pool size, JavaScript configuration, and mapper limits. It provides methods for creating an instance from a Config object and for accessing its configuration properties.

classes.name: DefaultMappingConfig
classes.description: An immutable class implementing MappingConfig, encapsulating mapping-related configuration settings such as buffer size, parallelism, thread pool size, JavaScript configuration, and mapper limits.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMappingConfig based on the provided Config object, loading configuration settings from the 'mapping' path.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size configuration parameter.

methods.name: getMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum thread pool size configuration parameter.

methods.name: getJavaScriptConfig
methods.description: Returns the JavaScriptConfig object associated with this configuration.

methods.name: getMapperLimitsConfig
methods.description: Returns the MapperLimitsConfig object associated with this configuration.
